conflicts.permit: When using the term “personal data” in this policy, we mean information that relates to you and allows us to identify you, either directly or in combination with other information that we possess.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not use IP addresses to personally identify users
conflicts.situation: Beltone collecting and processing an individual's IP address when they visit or use the website.
conflicts.reason: Section G categorically states IP addresses are not used to personally identify users, yet IP addresses constitute personal data (identifiers) collected and processed under general terms.
